# Berry crepes with cream cheese

Pancake mixes and most baking powders contain phosphate additives, which your body absorbs almost completely. Crepes need no baking powder at all: flour, egg and unsweetened almond milk make a thin batter that cooks in a minute. This makes 4 crepes, 2 per person.

**Serves 2** · 20 minutes · Lower potassium · Lower phosphorus · Vegetarian

!!! abstract "Carbohydrate per serving"
    **44 g carbohydrate** (about 3 carb choices of 15 g). For about 55 g, add ½ cup more blueberries (11 g) or a clementine (9 g).

Checked by `scripts/build_handbook.py`: sodium at most 600 mg per serving; "lower potassium" means at most 600 mg and "lower phosphorus" at most 300 mg per serving. See [how recipes are checked](index.md#how-the-recipes-are-checked).

Ingredients that are not in the app's food list (herbs, spices and a few others) add about 3 mg potassium per serving; they are counted above.

## Ingredients

| Ingredient | Amount | Grams |
|---|---|---|
| Flour, all-purpose | ½ cup all-purpose flour | 62 g |
| Egg, whole, raw | 2 large eggs | 100 g |
| Almond milk, unsweetened | ¾ cup unsweetened almond milk (no phosphate in the ingredients) | 196 g |
| Sugar, granulated | 1 tbsp sugar | 13 g |
| Vanilla extract | ½ tsp vanilla extract | 2.1 g |
| Butter, unsalted | 1 tbsp unsalted butter, for the pan | 14 g |
| Cream cheese | 4 tbsp cream cheese, softened | 58 g |
| Blueberries, raw | 1 cup blueberries, fresh or frozen and thawed | 148 g |
| Cinnamon, ground | a pinch of cinnamon | 0.5 g |

## Steps

1. Whisk the flour, eggs, almond milk, sugar and vanilla until smooth. Let the batter rest for 10 minutes if you have time.
2. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and rub it with a little butter. Pour in a quarter of the batter and tilt the pan so it covers the bottom thinly.
3. Cook for about 1 minute until the edges lift, flip, and cook 30 seconds more. Repeat to make 4 crepes.
4. Mix the cream cheese with the cinnamon. Spread 1 tablespoon on each crepe, add a quarter of the berries, and fold or roll.

## Why it works for kidneys

- No baking powder means no added phosphate: baking powders, even low-sodium ones, usually contain a phosphate.
- Cream cheese has far less phosphorus than other cheeses: about 16 mg per tablespoon.
- The almond milk is cooked into the crepes, so it does not count toward a fluid limit.

## Make it fit you

- **Other fruit:** strawberries or raspberries swap cup for cup and have less carbohydrate.
- **Freeze:** stack cooled crepes between sheets of baking paper, freeze, and warm them in a dry pan.
- **Rice milk instead of almond milk:** fine if the label has no phosphate; it adds about 9 g carbohydrate to the recipe.
